items.text: Selamat datang di Indonesia.
items.translation: Welcome to Indonesia.

items.text: Bali terkenal dengan pantainya yang indah.
items.translation: Bali is famous for its beautiful beaches.

items.text: Jakarta adalah kota terbesar di Indonesia.
items.translation: Jakarta is the largest city in Indonesia.

items.text: Saya ingin melihat Candi Borobudur.
items.translation: I want to see Borobudur Temple.

items.text: Yogyakarta adalah pusat budaya Jawa.
items.translation: Yogyakarta is the centre of Javanese culture.

items.text: Kami menonton matahari terbit di Gunung Bromo.
items.translation: We watched the sunrise at Mount Bromo.

items.text: Orang Bali merayakan Hari Raya Nyepi.
items.translation: The Balinese celebrate Nyepi.

items.text: Saat Nyepi, semua orang tinggal di rumah.
items.translation: During Nyepi, everyone stays at home.

items.text: Umat Islam berpuasa pada bulan Ramadan.
items.translation: Muslims fast during the month of Ramadan.

items.text: Banyak orang mudik saat Lebaran.
items.translation: Many people go back to their home towns for Lebaran (Eid).

items.text: Indonesia memiliki lebih dari tujuh belas ribu pulau.
items.translation: Indonesia has more than seventeen thousand islands.

items.text: Saya mau menyewa motor di Ubud.
items.translation: I want to rent a motorbike in Ubud.

items.text: Pantai Kuta ramai sekali.
items.translation: Kuta Beach is very crowded.

items.text: Kami berwisata ke Danau Toba.
items.translation: We are touring Lake Toba.

items.text: Jangan lupa membawa paspor.
items.translation: Don't forget to bring your passport.

items.text: Pengunjung pura wajib memakai sarung.
items.translation: Temple visitors must wear a sarong.

items.text: Wayang kulit adalah warisan budaya Indonesia.
items.translation: Wayang kulit (shadow puppetry) is part of Indonesia's cultural heritage.

items.text: Saya ingin belajar membatik di Yogyakarta.
items.translation: I want to learn batik-making in Yogyakarta.

items.text: Komodo hanya hidup di Indonesia.
items.translation: Komodo dragons live only in Indonesia.

items.text: Hari Kemerdekaan Indonesia jatuh pada tanggal 17 Agustus.
items.translation: Indonesian Independence Day falls on 17 August.

items.text: Visa saya berlaku tiga puluh hari.
items.translation: My visa is valid for thirty days.

items.text: Penerbangan dari Jakarta ke Denpasar memakan waktu dua jam.
items.translation: The flight from Jakarta to Denpasar takes two hours.

items.text: Tari Kecak dipentaskan di Pura Uluwatu.
items.translation: The Kecak dance is performed at Uluwatu Temple.

items.text: Malioboro adalah jalan terkenal di Yogyakarta.
items.translation: Malioboro is a famous street in Yogyakarta.

items.text: Saya ingin mencoba makanan khas Padang.
items.translation: I want to try the typical food of Padang.

items.text: Sawah terasering di Tegallalang sangat indah.
items.translation: The terraced rice fields in Tegallalang are very beautiful.

items.text: Di mana saya bisa menukar uang?
items.translation: Where can I exchange money?

items.text: Galungan adalah hari raya umat Hindu di Bali.
items.translation: Galungan is a Hindu holiday in Bali.
